nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Operator runbook for deploying a minimal Cloud Foundry bridge app and using `cf ssh -L` to tunnel into BTP's internal connectivity proxy, enabling the SAPMAP PP-impersonation live probe from a developer workstation. Covers app push, SSH enablement, connectivity-service token minting (HTTP 407 path), probe execution, and cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Eight Markdown sections covering setup, tunnel, token mint, probe run, cleanup, troubleshooting table, and cost — structured as a step-by-step operator recipe.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single static placeholder HTML page served by the bridge Cloud Foundry app; exists only so the staticfile buildpack has something to serve while the app acts as an SSH tunnel target.

nodes.name: manifest.yml
nodes.summary: Cloud Foundry application manifest declaring the `sapmap-probe-bridge` app: 64 MB single instance using the staticfile buildpack with a random shared-domain route, deployed solely to serve as a `cf ssh -L` tunnel endpoint into BTP's connectivity proxy.
